title: Timestral
abstract: arXiv:2610.37585v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce Timestral, a family of four time series foundation models for probabilistic forecasting, with 5M, 28M, 123M, and 209M parameters. Timestral sets a new state of the art on GIFT-Eval, TIME, and fev-bench, where Timestral-209M and Timestral-123M take the top two places on every metric. We achieve this with three ingredients: Decoupled Horizon Forecasting (DHF), which separates prediction tokens from the causally encoded context, so that longer horizons are trained without masking context and each observed value is both a forecast target and context for later forecasts; a covariate framework that natively supports known-future covariates within a causal architecture; and a two-stage pipeline that pretrains exclusively on a diverse, large-scale synthetic corpus before post-training on a mix of real and synthetic data with extended context. This report describes the model design and its benchmark results. Weights for all four mode

translated_title: Timestral（Timestral 时间序列基础模型）
translated_abstract: 我们提出 Timestral，这是一个面向概率预测的时间序列基础模型家族，包含 5M、28M、123M 和 209M 四种参数规模。Timestral 在 GIFT-Eval、TIME 和 fev-bench 上创造了新的最先进纪录，其中 Timestral-209M 和 Timestral-123M 在所有指标上包揽前两名。我们通过三项关键技术实现这一成果：解耦视界预测（Decoupled Horizon Forecasting, DHF），它将预测 token 与因果编码的上下文分离，从而在训练更长预测视界时无需屏蔽上下文，并且每个观测值既是预测目标又是后续预测的上下文；一个协变量框架，在因果架构中原生支持已知的未来协变量；以及一个两阶段流水线，先完全基于多样化的大规模合成语料库进行预训练，再在扩展上下文下的真实与合成数据混合集上进行后训练。本报告介绍了模型设计及其基准测试结果，并发布了全部四个模型的权重。
tldr: Timestral 是一系列面向概率预测的时间序列基础模型，通过解耦视界预测（DHF）、原生支持已知未来协变量的框架以及“先大规模合成数据预训练、后真实与合成混合数据后训练”的两阶段流程，在 GIFT-Eval、TIME 和 fev-bench 上取得了最先进的性能。
en_tdlr: Timestral is a family of time series foundation models for probabilistic forecasting that achieves state-of-the-art performance on GIFT-Eval, TIME, and fev-bench through Decoupled Horizon Forecasting, a natively covariate-aware causal architecture, and a two-stage pipeline pretraining on synthetic data and post-training on mixed real-synthetic data.
